title: Firmographic Enrichment
one_line: Fill headcount, industry, headquarters and revenue band on a company list, and report honestly which fields actually filled.
description: Fill headcount, industry, headquarters and revenue band on a company list, and report honestly which fields actually filled. Use when a list needs firmographics, when qualification needs company size, or when someone asks how complete their company data is.
paragraph: Firmographic enrichment always looks like it worked, because the rows that filled are visible and the rows that did not are blank rather than flagged. This skill enriches, then measures coverage per field, so a qualification rule built on a field that is only forty percent populated is caught before it silently disqualifies half the list.
keywords: how complete is my company data

requirements.cost: A free Apify account works. Each run bills your own Apify account at the actor's Store price: company-firmographic-enricher 0.004 USD per company.
Free. It starts the Mamba Labs MCP server with `npx`.

requirements_summary: Needs an Apify token (usage billed to your Apify account); Node.js 18+.
